Welcome to my website!

I am a PhD candidate in Economics at Université Libre de Bruxelles and [ECARES](https://ecares.ulb.be/).

I am also the co-founder of the [World Housing Inequality Database](https://www.worldhousingdata.com/).

I hold an MRes in Economics and Statistics from ECARES (2021) and an MSc Double Degree from [LUISS University](https://www.luiss.edu/) and the [Solvay Brussels School of Economics and Management](https://www.solvay.edu/) (2019). Here you can find my [CV](https://gmariani95.github.io/website/cv/CV_Giovanni_paolo_Mariani.pdf).

In my research I use a combination of spatial and administrative data to study two dimensions of inequality: housing and consumption of public goods. My agenda is supported by a research grant from the [F.R.S. - F.N.R.S.](https://www.frs-fnrs.be/en/)

**I am on the 2025-2026 academic job market!**
